label: WP Update
info:
[WP Update] flow tab for HeishaMoNR (PR material).
Automatic version check, settings backup AND restore (full global context to/from file, download endpoint),
plus one-click atomic update via the Node-RED Admin API (id-merge with rebuild safety nets).

Works with version.json in the repo root; if absent, automatically falls back to a repo scan of the plain GitHub page.
Admin login: user/password via the dashboard fields (password session-only in memory, never on disk) or via the environment variables WPU_ADMIN_USER / WPU_ADMIN_PASS. The Admin API URL is derived server-side (loopback 127.0.0.1:1880, or WPU_ADMIN_BASE for a non-standard port or httpAdminRoot) and is therefore not a dashboard field.
After an update the tab reports how many nodes are new/updated/removed/unchanged (counts in the toast; full name list in the Node-RED log).
[Download flows] button: fetches the full current flow via the Admin API and serves it via a token-gated endpoint (/wpupdate/flows, 24h, private link).
[Update tab] button: self-update of this tab from this repo's pinned version.json/update-tab.json (wpu-only merge, atomic POST /flows with snapshot + rev; rollback = older update-tab.json from git history).
See the included README for installation, behavior and edge cases.

label: Update tab
tooltip: Updates this tab itself from this repo. Safe to press any time: it first fetches the pinned version.json and compares it with the running tab; on "up to date" nothing changes. When newer: downloads update-tab.json (pinned + allowlisted), validates (wpu-only ids, version match), palette pre-flight, then replaces ONLY the wpu* nodes via one atomic POST /flows (snapshot + rev first). Rollback: older update-tab.json from git history.
